_sourcing_notes: Level-20 best-in-slot list for Warrior, taken from the Fury Warrior Icy Veins guide's own 'Level 20 Gear, Stat Priority, and Consumables' section (added 2026-09-24), cross-checked item-by-item against real Wowhead Forever item tooltips (wowhead.com/forever/item=<id>). The guide explicitly warns that Forever reworked dungeon loot and item stats from scratch, so Classic BIS/twink lists do NOT apply -- every item here is a real Forever item id with its own tooltip, not carried over from Classic knowledge. Only the guide's 'Best Choice' column is used (its 'Easy Alternative' items are skipped). Trinket and Ranged slots are not yet sourced (Wowhead rate-limited mid-session on 2026-09-25/26); Minor Recombobulator (Engineering) and Lil Timmy's Peashooter (world drop) are the guide's picks, still to fetch. Two of the two ring recommendations used (First Mate Band, neutral; Band of the Fist, Horde-only) are faction-split -- Alliance would instead want Seal of Wrynn, not yet sourced. Chausses of Westfall (legs) is Alliance-only; the guide's Horde-friendly alternate is Veteran's Chain Leggings (Blacksmithing), not yet sourced.
gaps: Trinket slot not sourced (Minor Recombobulator, Engineering)
Ranged slot not sourced (Lil Timmy's Peashooter, world drop)
Alliance ring alternate not sourced (Seal of Wrynn)
Horde leg alternate not sourced (Veteran's Chain Leggings)

This list is shared by all 3 Warrior specs per the guide; only the weapon choice is Fury-specific (dual-wield). Arms' own 2H weapon recommendation and Protection's shield/weapon+armor priorities are not yet sourced separately.
